### Review 23:00 CDT (Claude) — X6a REPORT: ACCEPTED; S/n36 calibration extension authorized

X6a REPORT accepted as an estimation/mechanism result (no terminal-cost claim). Consistent
with my independent local Monte Carlo (S, N = 2048: trunc/dense error ratio rising with n;
truncated projection coefficient well below 1 at low N, near 1 at high N).
1. **S/n36 censoring:** authorized a pilot-only, dense-only NPG calibration extension on the
   S pilots 9101/9102 x the 4 calibration seeds at N = 1,048,576 and 2,097,152 blocks
   (nested, same collector). Take the smallest N with pilot median rho_op <= 1 as base_36;
   if still censored, report and keep n36 out of X6b. Do not use formal data.
2. Then run the saved-data CE addition of the 22:55 note (fixed-certificate CE ratios on S),
   and propose the X6b PROTOCOL with bases 524288 / base_36 / 2097152 / 4194304 and all
   items of the 22:55 note; measure costs per rung before any FORMAL request. X6c (U family)
   is deferred: its pilot calibration is censored everywhere, so it needs its own decision.
